settings.inputs: normalized values then observation masks; flatten 12 hourly rows
settings.normalization: per-channel training-patient float64 mean and std + 1e-6 over all 37 observations; coupling_index simulator convention
settings.split: seed-0 default_rng permutation, 280 A_train / 60 A_val / 60 B patients
settings.validation_note: A_val selects alpha and is also reported; B is an untouched same-generator patient holdout
settings.bootstrap_note: paired patient-cluster percentile intervals, frozen fits; all windows of each resampled patient retained
settings.constant_target_note: Zero own RMSE gives null cells. Full mean is null if any of its six off-diagonal cells is undefined; no epsilon or partial mean is substituted.

cinc.comparison_note: CinC uses four organs and 12 directed pairs; simulator uses three organs and six pairs. CinC B is an external hospital; simulator B is a same-generator patient holdout. Missingness and channel coverage differ. The hourly estimator is shared; the measurement systems are not equivalent.

source_derived_caveats: Cardiovascular dynamics and treatment/sepsis schedules do not depend on kappa in the frozen source; only the renal observation and metabolic production term change.
UO(kappa) = 1.12 + kappa * (UO(1) - 1.12). For kappa > 0, per-channel normalization nearly removes this affine amplitude change (apart from the 1e-6 scale offset and float32 storage).

The frozen capillary leak remains active to hour 36 without compensating fluids; the requested long horizon can reach nonphysiological states. Inspect measured ranges rather than assuming extension of the six-hour calibration is valid.
reasons: An index-to-kappa mapping requires a defined, sufficiently ordered curve.
The scalar means average different organ/channel sets in simulator and CinC.
This task does not measure a graph model advantage threshold.
Predictive gain is not a causal coupling estimate.

A_val.mean_values_and_denominators: See datasets.*.ridge.splits and cinc.means.ridge; no means are averaged across kappa.

B.mean_values_and_denominators: See datasets.*.ridge.splits and cinc.means.ridge; no means are averaged across kappa.

long_horizon_assessment.evidence: Nonpositive MAP is nonphysiological; late cardiac-output and lactate flatness is reported per kappa in trajectory_diagnostics.

interpretation.conclusion: The requested hourly estimator was computed, but its mean is undefined at kappa=0 and the long trajectories enter nonphysiological states. CinC cannot defensibly be assigned kappa approximately zero from this calibration. A graph-model benefit threshold is not measured by this task.
